sequence.description: The log's head once the command committed: its last event, or the head it saw when it appended none.

changed.description: False for a command that was accepted and changed nothing, so appended no event.

sequence.description: The log's head when the command was rejected.

reason.description: Why the command was rejected, the code of its error: not_found when its target does not exist.

code.description: A stable error code in snake case.

error.description: The rejection as an error: its code (the reason), a message for people and structured data.

receipt.description: A command's receipt: accepted (with the head sequence after it and whether it changed anything) or rejected (with the reason and the error). A retry with the same commandId answers the same receipt.

result.description: The method's result, present when this request applied the command; absent on a retry and on a rejection.

accountId.description: The account whose directory is being signed in.

state.description: Where a sign-in is: starting, awaiting-code (the verification URL is published), submitting (a code was written to the provider's CLI), or ended: done (the status read found the account signed in), failed, expired (ten minutes without a code, or a submission that never finished) or cancelled.

url.description: The verification URL a person opens to sign in, once the provider's CLI has printed it; null until then.

expiresAt.description: When the sign-in expires if it is still waiting: ten minutes after it started, or after the code was written.

posix.description: For sh, bash or zsh: the directory variable set on the command, the directory single-quoted.

powershell.description: For PowerShell: the directory variable set, then the executable called, each path single-quoted.

fallback.description: The exact command that signs the account's directory in from a terminal on the environment's machine, in POSIX and PowerShell renderings.

error.description: Why the sign-in failed, expired or was cancelled, when there is more to say; null otherwise.

cause.description: Why a failed or cancelled sign-in ended, where a client words it apart: code-refused (the provider's CLI failed after the code was written to it), restarted (the environment restarted while it ran), account-removed; absent otherwise, from a person's cancel, and from environments that do not say.

signIn.description: A sign-in of an account's directory: its state, the verification URL, when it expires, the fallback command, and why it ended when it did not succeed.
